features.name: Sustainability Value Entries
features.description: New capability to track emissions similar to how costs are tracked with standard value entries. Supports inbound emissions from items at present, with plans to extend to item charges in the next wave.
caveats: Limited to average costing method currently
Missing print functionality for sales invoice in this release

features.name: Value Chain Tracking in Transfer Orders
features.description: Enables tracking of internal transport emissions through transfer orders by adding carbon equivalent fields. Calculates emissions per unit when posting transfer shipments.
caveats: Emissions not shown in posted transfer receipt, only in posted transfer shipment
Limited to internal transport use case
Entry required at line level, not header level

features.name: Emissions from Production and Assembly Orders
features.description: Extension allows tracking of emissions impact from production orders and assembly orders to calculate new sustainability values for finished goods.
caveats: Feature is part of public preview
Details not fully demonstrated in this session

features.name: Sales Invoice Emissions Display
features.description: Sustainability values including total emissions are displayed on sales invoices and posted sales invoices without print functionality in this release.
caveats: Print functionality not available in this release

features.name: Value Chain Tracking Setup
features.description: New setup field in Sustainability Setup under Procurement fast tab to enable value chain tracking. When enabled, causes system to post both sustainability ledger entries and sustainability value entries.
caveats: Recommendation to test in sandbox first

features.name: Item Card Emissions Fields
features.description: Item card now shows emissions fields for CO2, methane, and nitrous oxide. Users can enter manual values and calculate CO2 equivalent, or values are automatically updated from purchase documents.
caveats: Manual entry required if no prior purchase history

features.name: Automatic Emission Updates from Purchase Documents
features.description: When purchase invoice is posted, sustainability value entries are automatically created and item emissions are updated with actual values from the purchase document.
caveats: Only posts sustainability value entry if value chain tracking is enabled

features.name: Sustainability Ledger Entry vs Value Entry Posting
features.description: System behavior differs based on whether value chain tracking is enabled. When enabled, both sustainability ledger entry and sustainability value entry are posted. Without enabling, only sustainability ledger entry is posted.
